subject: Proposal: co-term conversion + 3yr convertible top-up path for Nimbus Health
messages:
From: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Mon, 2 Jun 2025 17:15:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Renewal window and capacity planning

Tessa —

Thanks for the call this morning. Quick follow-up from our side: leadership wants to simplify our multiple subscriptions into a single co-term agreement and also explore a 3-year commitment that lets us front-load credits in year 1, then convert a portion into an annual top-up ladder tied to usage. Two constraints: (1) procurement needs predictable invoicing cadence aligned to fiscal year, (2) we need the option to burst additional capacity for pilot months without renegotiation.

Could you send a concrete proposal with pricing bands and a simple mutual action plan so we can circulate with finance? Also attaching a rough internal model (will send official file if helpful).

—Marco
[Attachment: Nimbus_TopUp_Note.txt (text/plain)]

From: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai
To: Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>, Sara Lim <sara.lim@nimbushealth.com>
Cc: priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 3 Jun 2025 09:08:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: co-term conversion + 3yr convertible top-up path for Nimbus Health

Marco / Sara —

Great to follow up. Based on our conversation I sketched a practical path that balances your fiscal predictability with flexibility for pilot bursts:

- Convert current subscriptions into a single 3-year contract with co-term on 2026-01-01.
- Year 1: Frontloaded credits equal to ~40% of committed annual tokens; these are redeemable as base usage or converted into quarterly top-ups.
- Year 2–3: Convertible ladder — every quarter Nimbus can elect to convert remaining credits into locked capacity (with guaranteed pricing) or keep credits for variable usage.
- Burst policy: ability to burst at negotiated overage rates up to 2x baseline for up to 2 months per FY, with automated fallback to a compatible lower-cost model when capacity constrained.

Attached is a simple top-up model (xlsx) and a draft Master Agreement outline showing the term and co-term mechanics. If procurement needs a single-line invoice cadence, we can set billing to annual in arrears but provide quarterly statements for internal tracking.

Next steps I propose: 1) you share any internal budget window constraints, 2) we lock pricing bands and finalize MA redlines, 3) set a mutual action plan and target sign date. I copied Priyom for onboarding/CS comments.

Thanks —
Tessa Morgan
Account Executive | Redwood Inference
[tel] (415) 555-0189
[Attachment: Nimbus_TopUp_Model.xlsx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.spreadsheetml.sheet)]

Also, procurement needs the MA redline tracked — can you send the draft as Word with mergeable clauses?

Cc: kimberly_park@redwood.ai, priyom_das@redwood.ai
Date: Thu, 5 Jun 2025 11:18:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: co-term conversion + 3yr convertible top-up path for Nimbus Health

Sara / Marco —

Answers inline and next actions: 

1) Conversion notice window: we can support a 30-day conversion notice for credits -> committed capacity. When conversion occurs mid-FY we will prorate billing so Nimbus's accounting can reflect the change in the same fiscal quarter.

2) Billing / invoicing: option A — annual invoice in arrears (single-line) + quarterly statements; option B — quarterly invoicing to match conversion cadence. We can be flexible; finance can pick preferred cadence and we'll adapt pricing slightly (quarterly invoices carry a 0.5% administrative surcharge).

3) MA redline: attached as Word (Draft_MA_3yr_Term_v1.docx) with the convertible ladder and burst appendix drafted. Please send back redlines; legal usually turns in 3–5 business days.

Internal notes for CS/Onboarding (Priyom): if they convert early, onboarding should plan for a capacity cutover window of 48–72 hours for KV cache prewarming and routing updates. Priyom, can you confirm an internal ops checklist and estimated lead time for a 2x burst?

If procurement approves the 30-day conversion and billing cadence, I'll produce a one-page commercial term sheet by EOD Friday.

Thanks —
Tessa
[Attachment: Draft_MA_3yr_Term_v1.docx (application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document)]

From: priyom_das@redwood.ai
To: tessa_morgan@redwood.ai, kimberly_park@redwood.ai
Cc: Sara Lim <sara.lim@nimbushealth.com>, Marco Ruiz <m.ruiz@nimbushealth.com>
Date: Fri, 6 Jun 2025 13:02:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Proposal: co-term conversion + 3yr convertible top-up path for Nimbus Health

Tessa / team —

Confirming ops feasibility: we can support the 30-day conversion window and the 48–72 hour capacity cutover with the following checklist:
- Pre-conversion token accounting audit (24h)
- KV/prewarm job scheduled (48h prior to cutover)
- Routing and model pinning change during maintenance window (2h)
- Monitoring and rollback plan (automated fallback to compatible variant)

Estimated lead time for 2x burst: 10 business days to guarantee on-demand dedicated GPU availability in PRIME regions; we can support a shorter best-effort 72h burst for lower SLOs but it requires pre-approval and capacity reservation.

Kimberly — for approval on the commercial concession: I'm ok with a 12% blended discount across the 3-year committed consumption if Nimbus signs a convertible ladder and permits annual invoicing in arrears. Kimberly, please confirm if Sales Ops is comfortable with the discount band and the proposed administrative surcharge for quarterly invoicing.

—Priyom
